notes: §2002:13.16.38.2 SR6: the digit positions of a numeric-edited item range from 1 through 31. For a floating-point edited item AnalyzeFloatEdited asks EditionInfo.MaxFloatEditedSignificandDigits (31 at COBOL-2002, 36 from 2014); +9(32)E+99 is refused COBOL1658 at --std 2002 and accepted from 2014; 31 significand digits are accepted (PB5712). The fixed-point numeric and numeric-edited arms already refuse 32 digit positions at 2002 (COBOL0801).
